software_class: developer tool, command line interface, SDK, plugin, or MCP server

options.name: Python CLI tool
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when single-binary distribution is required.
options.rationale: Uses familiar stdlib and packaging paths.
options.risks: Loose typing can hide interface drift.

options.name: Node CLI tool
options.when_to_use: Tooling targets JavaScript ecosystems or package scripts.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when Python or compiled distribution fits better.

options.name: Compiled binary tool
options.when_to_use: Distribution, startup speed, or single-file delivery matters.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when rapid scripting is more valuable.

options.name: MCP server
options.when_to_use: External agents need structured tool access.
options.when_not_to_use: Avoid when a local CLI is enough.
options.rationale: Exposes clear tool contracts for agent workflows.
options.tradeoffs: Tool permissions and auditability become central.
options.risks: Unsafe tool exposure can create serious risk.
